note_type.description: Type of note (default: semantic). Use `source_record` for what an external source asserted (web/video), `claim` for a single checkable proposition, `unsourced_synthesis` for your own uncited reasoning. Do not invent a type — an unknown value is stored but never labelled or recalled correctly.

source_context.description: Optional source context (e.g. session ID, document URL)

event_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp of the event this note describes

lat.description: Optional: where what the note describes happened (latitude, WGS 84), with `lon`. Only for a note about an event or observation at a place (a reported incident, a ship's position); a note that merely mentions a place is found near it already.

provenance.description: Source authority flag: who/what produced this note. Default: user_input for an outside MCP client, synthesis_inference for the brain's own jobs, chats and agents (which cannot claim user_input).
